entries.title: Jeremiah 26:1
segments: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came from the LORD, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:2
segments: So says the LORD: Stand in the court of the LORD's house and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD's house, all the words that I command you to speak to them; do not keep back a word.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:3
segments: It may be that they will listen, and each man turn from his evil way, that I may repent of the evil which I plan to do to them because of the evil of their doings.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:4
segments: And you shall say to them, So says the LORD: If you will not listen to Me, to walk in My law which I have set before you,

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:5
segments: to listen to the words of My servants the prophets whom I am sending to you (both rising up early and sending them, but you have not listened);

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:6
segments: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:7
segments: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:8
segments: And it happened when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded [him] to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, You shall surely die!

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:9
segments: Why have you prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be wasted, without inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:10
segments: When the rulers of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house to the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entrance of the New Gate of the LORD's [house].

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:11
segments: And the priests and the prophets spoke to the rulers and to all the people, saying, [Let] a death sentence be for this man, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:12
segments: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the rulers and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:13
segments: So now make your ways and your doings good, and obey the voice of the LORD your God. And the LORD will repent of the evil that He has spoken against you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:14
segments: As for me, behold, I [am] in your hand. Do with me as seems good and right to you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:15
segments: But know for certain that if you put me to death you shall surely bring innocent blood on yourselves, and on this city, and on its people. For truly the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:16
segments: Then the rulers and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets, There [is] not a sentence of death for this man; for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:17
segments: Then some of the elders of the land rose up and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:18
segments: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, So says the LORD of hosts: Zion shall be plowed [like] a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house like the high places of a forest.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:19
segments: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah indeed put him to death? Did he not fear the LORD, and pray to the LORD, and the LORD repented of the evil which He had spoken against them? So we are doing great evil against our souls.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:20
segments: And there was also a man who prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:21
segments: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the rulers, heard his words, the king tried to put him to death. But when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled and went into Egypt.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:22
segments: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt; Elnathan the son of Achbor, and men with him into Egypt.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:23
segments: And they brought Urijah out of Egypt and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword and threw his dead body into the graves of the common people.

entries.title: Jeremiah 26:24
segments: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
